snippet.title: Summer's Gone - Season 2 - Constellations | Trailer [GOG]
snippet.description: The story continues. The characters you've grown to know are back and now with more punch than ever.  Relationships move forward. Some turn intimate, others grow tense. New bonds form, old ones shift, and rivalries begin to take shape.
